_meta.description: DEX routers and aggregators. A transfer into one of these is a swap, not a payment or a cash-out: the sender received a different asset back in the same transaction.
_meta.provenance: Imported from brianleect/etherscan-labels @ 923aba72c7e2d0682f7ae6194b6140bd90668dc9, a published scrape of the explorer's own label pages, categories ['dex']; only entries whose explorer name ends in 'Router' (or 0x's Exchange Proxy) were taken, and each was verified to carry contract bytecode.
